tensorLattice.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.tensorLattice
tensorLattice.statement:
abbrev KummerChart.PairingSide.tensorLattice := JumpLattice.mk _ (fun i ↦ (S.U i).image₂ (· + ·)

thirdSide.name: Lift.Pairing.thirdSide
thirdSide.statement:
abbrev Pairing.thirdSide : PairingSide O := let T := S.tensorLattice S'; ⟨⟨_, fun i ↦
    insert 0 ((T.U i).image (-· - 1)), _, T.inClass.dual, (by grind [T.embJumps_subset ·])⟩, ⟨O, 1⟩,
    .toSpanSingleton _ _ P.thirdClass, by simp⟩

deepElements.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.deepElements

Reaches.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.Reaches

pointsOver.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.pointsOver

HasDeepPoint.name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.HasDeepPoint
HasDeepPoint.statement:
def HasDeepPoint (cut : _ → Prop) l (o o' z : _ → ℕ → ℤ → ℤ) (Q : Prop) := ∃ d r,
    (S.pointsOver c' i' e (o i') d).Nonempty ∧ cut (i'.stepBack r) ∧ ∀ a, ∀ u ∈ S.U (i'.stepBack a),
  ∀ v ∈ S'.U (i'.stepBack a), -z i' a (-u - v - 1) - d a u < min (-v) (o' i' a v) ∧
  (Q → stdExponent l a u ≤ o i' a u ∧ -frobExponent r 0 (z (i'.stepBack r)) a (-u - v - 1) - d a u <
  min (o' i' a v) (frobExponent l 0 (o' (i'.stepBack l)) a v))
